specific_events: Reinsurance-to-close (RITC) with Enstar's Starstone Syndicate 2008 (affecting 2015 and prior)

prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC transaction effective 1 January 2018 with Enstar's Starstone Syndicate 2008 in respect of all 2015 and prior business; the financial impact of this transaction is reflected in the value of the 2015 and prior liabilities at 31 December 2017.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,394.7m at 1 January 2017. Analysis of claims development (gross triangle) indicates net favourable development on prior years of approximately GBP 22.0m (gross) in 2017, driven by favourable claims development across older underwriting years and influenced by reinsurance arrangements (including a reinsurance-to-close arrangement referenced with Enstar). The movement represents a small release (about 1.6% of opening gross claims outstanding).
raw_causal_phrases: The gross and net provisions at 31 December 2017 include margin held above actuarial best estimate of GBP 18.7 million (2016: gross and net provisions included margin of GBP 55.5 million).
No margin was held for 2015 and prior reserves due to the agreed value of the RITC with Enstar.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Provisions table (explicit). No explicit sentence stating a gross prior-year movement was found; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) on page 31. A reinsurance-to-close (RITC) arrangement is referenced in the notes and may affect comparability of the triangle for older years. Exact narrative text explicitly stating the gross prior year movement was not located.
